paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: Conceptualized and operationalized targets by year along with the distribution of datasets. Targeted refers to datasets that have explicitly mentioned at least one target in their construct definition (i.e., in the conceptualization phase) and/or publications in which the authors define concrete measures to ensure and validate the presence of at least one target group in the data (i.e., in the operationalization phase). Untargeted refers to all other datasets that do not meet these two criteria. Note that the data for 2022 is only partially available (as described in our Methods and Data Section).
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized as “Targeted” or “Untargeted” across the years 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents “Year”, with categories labeled 2012 through 2022 in chronological order. The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, with tick marks every 20 units.  For each year, there are two bars: a blue bar representing “Untargeted” datasets and an orange bar representing “Targeted” datasets. In 2012, both bars are extremely short, extending to approximately 1 unit. The heights increase over time, with the blue “Untargeted” bar for 2021 reaching approximately 61 units and the orange “Targeted” bar for 2021 reaching approximately 98 units – these represent the tallest bars for each category. The bars are arranged chronologically by year, and show stacked values for each year; the orange “Targeted” bars are built atop the blue “Untargeted” bars. The 2022 bars are notably shorter than those of 2021, with the orange “Targeted” bar reaching approximately 31 units and the blue “Untargeted” bar reaching approximately 10 units. No bars or data points are visibly emphasized.
